# finance-overview

Composes metrics and selectable transactions into an embeddable finance overview without owning navigation or state.

![finance-overview preview](../images/finance-overview-phone.jpg)

More previews: [tablet](../images/finance-overview-tablet.jpg), [accessibility](../images/finance-overview-accessibility.jpg)

## Install

```sh
python3 Scripts/install.py finance-overview --destination <your-target-dir>
```

Then add package https://github.com/mangobyte-dev/swiftui-ui-registry.git (from 0.1.0 up to the next minor version) and link product SwiftUIRegistryFoundations

## Usage

```swift
FinanceOverview(
    "Overview",
    balanceTitle: "Available balance",
    balance: Text(12_480.32, format: .currency(code: "USD")),
    changeTitle: "Monthly change",
    change: Text(0.082, format: .percent),
    sectionTitle: "Recent activity",
    transactions: [
        FinanceTransactionItem(
            id: "salary",
            title: Text("Salary"),
            subtitle: Text("Yesterday"),
            amount: Text(2_450, format: .currency(code: "KWD")),
            systemImage: "building.columns.fill",
            tone: .positive
        )
    ],
    onSelect: { id in }
)
```
